header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioners nor any intimation received. This petition was
body: filed in the year 2023 and was lastly fixed in the court on 02.02.2023, and even on that date none was present on behalf of the petitioners. Even thereafter no efforts were made to proceed with the same.

Perusal of the prayer clause reflects that the petitioner is seeking an inquiry in FIR which pertains to the year 2022, and by the lapse of time, this petition has become infructuous and is hereby disposed of.
